principle: Each small 'yes' makes the next easier (consistency principle). Never jump the ladder; step back one rung on a 'no'. Genuine value at every step.

ladder.name: agree_interest
ladder.ask_en: Want me to show a couple of good picks?

ladder.name: engage_product
ladder.ask_en: This one fit what you had in mind?
ladder.ask_ur: Ye aap ke zehn mein jo tha usse milta hai?

ladder.name: commit
ladder.ask_en: Shall I take you straight there to grab it?
ladder.ask_ur: Seedha le chaloon le lene ke liye?

either_or.en: Want the [A] or should I show more first?

yes_if.en: If this matches what you want, shall I send it over?
yes_if.ur: Agar ye sahi lage to bhej doon?

recover_from_no: Step back one rung; offer to keep the link handy. Never push the same ask again.
